* # DESIGN AND IMPLEMENTATION OF A 9 V DC LED INDICATOR CIRCUIT    

* 

* # 1.INTRODUCTION

* #                  A 9 V DC LED indicator circuit is a simple electronic circuit used to provide a visual indication of the presence of a DC power supply. The circuit uses an LED connected in series with a current-limiting resistor to ensure safe operation. It is assembled on a solderless breadboard for easy testing and prototyping. 

* # 2\. Objective                  To design and implement a simple 9 V DC LED indicator circuit using a current-limiting resistor on a solderless breadboard.

* #    3\. Components Required

  * 9 V DC battery – 1  
  * Red LED – 1  
  * Current-limiting resistor – 1(1K)  
  * Solderless breadboard – 1  
  * Jumper wires – As required

* 4\. Circuit Configuration  
                 The resistor and LED are connected in series. The resistor limits the current through the LED and protects it from excessive current.  
*   
*   
  5\. Working Principle  
                When the 9 V battery is connected, current flows through the resistor and the forward-biased LED. The LED converts electrical energy into visible light, providing a visual indication that the circuit is powered and operational.

  7\. Construction  
               The circuit is assembled on a solderless breadboard using jumper wires. The LED is connected with the correct polarity, while the resistor is placed in series with the LED. The battery provides the required DC supply.

* #    8\. Testing and Verification

  * Verify the LED polarity before powering the circuit.  
  * Confirm the resistor value and connections.  
  * Check all jumper-wire and breadboard connections.  
  * Ensure there are no short circuits.

            9\. Result  
                 The 9 V DC LED indicator circuit was successfully assembled and tested on a
